description: UK Power Networks Secondary Site Utilisation is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction This dataset shows the utilisation band of our secondary sites across our three networks, over 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025. This dataset is a redacted version of an annual regulatory submission to Ofgem. The data consists of a single utilisation value over a year for each of UK Power Networks secondary substation. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2025-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
